name: simkv
algorithm: a write-ahead-log key-value store run three lives per seed on std.sim's simulated disk, crashing at a seeded point in the first two and checking every recovery against the committed writes (README.md).

skip.go: no std simulated Io (testing/fstest.MapFS is a read-only file tree with no crash model)

notes: Written by std-sim (status/std-sim.md). A row with no baseline: it tracks std.sim's own cost per seed across M6, and no ratio is published from it.

SIM-R10 (2026-11-07) changed the crash point's span (half the draws over the first 128 operations, half log-uniform up to 8 million), so fewer short lives crash: the checksums' crash counts were recomputed then (168512 and 16811 before).
